description: ShedKeeper: a copy before the changes it recognizes, the trash instead of deletion

hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_tool.py" ]; then python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_tool.py" --via-plugin; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage": "ShedKeeper cannot run: Python was not found (or `python` is the Microsoft Store placeholder), or Python itself failed on the hook file -- its protection is OFF: no copy is saved before an edit, nothing goes to the trash.
